prompt: Call the church softball league championship like a WWE title match. Pastor Dave is 0-2 in championship games.
response:
*[BOOM! Pyrotechnics erupt over the freshly mowed outfield]*

LADIES AND GENTLEMEN... WELCOME TO THE MAIN EVENT OF THE EVENING!

The tension in this sanctuary of softball is THICKER THAN GRANDMA'S POTATO SALAD at the potluck! And here comes the challenger now—

PASTOR! DAVE!

*[Crowd erupts as a man in wire-rimmed glasses adjusts his batting gloves]*

Look at the STEELY DETERMINATION in his eyes, folks! But we KNOW the history! We KNOW the demons he's wrestling with tonight! ZERO and TWO in championship games! TWICE this man has climbed the mountain! TWICE he has been cast down into the valley of the shadow of DEFEAT!

Two years ago—the DROPPED FLY BALL heard 'round the fellowship hall! Last season—struck out looking with the bases LOADED! You could hear a hymnal drop!

But tonight is DIFFERENT, ladies and gentlemen! Tonight Pastor Dave has that look! The look of a man who has spent all week in PRAYER... and in the BATTING CAGES!

*[He steps to the plate. The pitcher winds up.]*

CAN HE DO IT?! Can he EXORCISE the demons of championships past?! Will he finally lift that trophy over his head and SPIKE it through the announcer's table—metaphorically, of course, because we have to give that table back to the youth group!

THE PITCH IS ON THE WAY—

*[Crack of the bat]*

OH MY! HE GOT ALL OF IT! IT IS GOING! IT IS GOING! GET OUT THE COMMUNION WINE BECAUSE WE ARE CELEBRATING—

...

*[Ball lands two feet foul]*

Ohhh, JUST foul. Strike one. Okay. We're still going. Still 0-and-1.

*[Whispering]* Come on, Dave. This is your redemption arc.
